Text: The https://t.co/ctK7cBlm9t factory contract is live on Robinhood Chain. We are targeting platform launch for Aug 14.

0x626C3d09B65bF5d1D40E0D5F25e19fa49783B3D4

Every https://t.co/ctK7cBlm9t token deploys through this contract, straight into a @SushiSwap pool. Anything else is fake.

75% of every trading fee flows straight back to the ecosystem:

Community — 25%. Every fee on every token feeds the community pool, and every week it buys back and burns the top 3 tokens. More volume → more buy pressure → more burned supply. That's the flywheel.

[REDACTED] — 30%. Accruing onchain from day one. Your activity will not be forgotten.

Deployers — 20%. The full 1B supply launches on the curve, deployers hold nothing unless they buy it like everyone else (dev buys: same price, atomic, in the launch transaction). Their upside is a fee stream for the life of the token. Paid to build, not to dump.

Platform — 25%. Runs https://t.co/ctK7cBlm9t.

Additional rewards will be announced soon in collaboration with SushiSwap.

Every token's split is locked into immutable bytecode at launch.
